status_definitions.conditional: Select only if preceding observations support the change.
status_definitions.blocked_human: Requires willing real participants; no agent roleplay substitute.
status_definitions.active: Assigned and in progress; not completed.
status_definitions.done: Acceptance criteria met with linked evidence.
status_definitions.not_selected: Explicitly closed by a recorded design decision.

gates.requirement: The November 4 readiness handoff preserves Small Hours and Bell, permits the bounded shared-helper correction for Vivid, and separates supported HTTP verification from human studies arranged later. Human observations still determine subsequent feature and release decisions.

Retain each lane’s six-title roster, broad-family coverage, substituted editions and unfinished endpoints. The October 28–30 records and November archive uploads add inspectable evidence, not human validation or six completed journeys. Current competitor and pilot packets carry the qualifications; historical original-roster counts remain separate.
Observe actual people using the per-game protocol; automated checks and emotional agent prose are not human evidence.

tasks.title: Publish the October 22 intake and six-slot provenance ledger
tasks.deliverable: A current M1–M6 ledger pinned to ca7fb8e, with original editions, explicit substitutes, actual endpoints and remaining social questions.
acceptance_criteria: Pin the October 22 rebuilt package to ca7fb8ea0fa7ceb1a9fd1c8ab238a71a47e9c649; verify that game and test files remain unchanged from 822366ad. Keep filing dates separate from the underlying October 13–20 sessions and October 15 reshoots.

Classify Make it Meme as lobby-only; Fireboy & Watergirl as a Level 1 tooling fragment; and Twin Flames as a reported solo Level 1 unit with uncertain later progression. One operator and page-shell captures do not establish human cooperation or independently verify gameplay.

Record the hanabi.live game with two bots as 57 turns and 18 points, not a perfect 25-point game or a BGA human session. Record GeoGuessr main modes as unplayed and HorrorGuessr as six runs with zero days and pins, without a successful guess-to-feedback cycle.

Identify Townscaper as the official web prototype with six reported structures and a save URL, without independently verified reopening; count its shared M5/V5 session once. Keep Florence unplayed and novena as a reported two-cycle narrative substitute, not equivalent tactile domestic play.

Separate verified images/transcripts, report-based progression, source/critic evidence and human observations. State the lost questions for every substitute; close only the lane intake, leaving qualifying journeys, original-edition questions and human validation open.
tasks.completion_note: The current six-slot ledger reconciles the October 22 package at ca7fb8e and supersedes the older intake-only zero-gameplay tally. Runtime/test identity is preserved; original-edition and human social questions remain open.

tasks.owner_role: Small Hours research lead + access coordinator
tasks.title: Prepare the remaining original-edition and social comparisons
tasks.deliverable: Access-conditional session briefs for the unresolved human social and original-edition questions, using the reconciled six-slot ledger as the starting point.
acceptance_criteria: For a human Hanabi comparison, specify exact platform, legitimate access, separate views and real partners; the completed hanabi.live bot session does not answer human convention/coordination questions. For GeoGuessr, specify the intended consumer mode, host/guest conditions and bounded location-feedback unit rather than treating HorrorGuessr as that session.

Keep full-edition Townscaper and Florence access/device needs explicit. The known official web-prototype record and novena substitute provide limited contrasts; they do not establish the original native journeys.
Retain the recovered Townscaper save URL and shared M5/V5 provenance without claiming reopening. Any future re-entry check is a separately dated observation, not another distinct title.

Write remaining journey targets with entry, meaningful decision, mistake/recovery when encountered, bounded ending or finish, exit and actual repeat. Mark each stage planned or observed, and name the question each substitute leaves unanswered.

Reconcile six distinct titles and family rules before final comparative claims, including at least two outside narrative/deduction, no more than two per family and at most one occasion comparator; record the taxonomy and endpoint limits instead of converting six slots into six completed journeys.
This preparation does not purchase licenses, create accounts, recruit participants or launch new competitor sessions. Unavailable access and missing human partners remain explicit gaps.
tasks.completion_note: Records/provenance now reconciled; original social/edition access and qualifying journeys remain pending. Substitutions do not silently close BGA/private GeoGuessr/full Townscaper/Florence questions.

tasks.owner_role: Human research facilitator + Small Hours researcher
tasks.title: Complete staged competitor journeys, starting with M1/M2
tasks.deliverable: An M1/M2 human comparison milestone, followed by scoped M3–M6 studies as access permits, each with a journey, system observations and an art board.
acceptance_criteria: Use real willing participants; disclose observer assistance and prior knowledge. An agent controlling both sides does not satisfy the social question.
M1 records join, authoring, reveal/judgment, three agreed rounds and the actual repeat/leave decision; distinguish authorship, recognition, surprise and scoring.
M2 uses a keyboard capable of WASD, arrows and held inputs; records role division, introduction, a coordination-level completion, natural recovery if encountered and continue/leave.

After SH-02 resolves access, M3 targets a complete Hanabi game/debrief; M4 an agreed private location session/recalled detail; M5 a creation/revision/finish/save cycle in the selected edition; M6 the full story/ending and recalled interaction. Unreached targets stay explicitly partial or blocked.
Record active play, setup and notes separately; preserve the October 20 tool limitation as that session’s limitation, not a general game defect.
Store exact stop points and capture provenance; incomplete sessions retain their partial status and do not satisfy the full-journey gate.

tasks.title: Settle the unchanged-build six-pair protocol
tasks.deliverable: An unchanged-build first-six-pairs protocol, neutral facilitator script, registration template and observation forms pinned to the current frozen baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Pin baseline source ca7fb8ea0fa7ceb1a9fd1c8ab238a71a47e9c649, whose runtime/test files match 822366ad; identify the eight-file export with inventory SHA-256 fa4ca1930fc1964d929bca9704c5f0bba89dc9cc46208d34294a1e1ae5c458e3. Record the actual artifact identity for every later session.

Prepare a first-six-pairs registration rule that retains failed and abandoned attempts; leave IDs, recruitment, timestamps and results blank until a real facilitator arranges them. Keep consent/contact mappings private.

Provide neutral prompts and observation fields for entry, private choice/prediction, handoff, reveal, actual offscreen activity, optional writing, save/leave and voluntary repeat, without explaining the intended payoff.

Record each person’s contribution, help, stopping, device/browser, time to reveal and voluntary comments. Do not collect or solicit keepsakes by default; allow stopping without explanation, seated/imaginary participation and blank writing.

Predeclare the diagnostic thresholds: at least 5/6 pairs reach reveal unaided, 4/6 both contribute and 3/6 voluntarily save or replay. These are formative criteria, not population conversion or retention estimates.

Use the unchanged build for all baseline attempts. Explicitly supersede the old facilitator no-prediction comparison; prediction/writing friction is recorded qualitatively before any variant decision.
tasks.completion_note: The unchanged-build protocol and blank forms are ready for ca7fb8e’s frozen artifact. The prior no-prediction facilitator comparison is superseded. No participants, registration IDs or human results are fabricated.

tasks.title: Observe six willing pairs on the unchanged build
tasks.deliverable: Six de-identified pair observations, an actual-sample summary and the three gate counts.
acceptance_criteria: Record recruitment context and willingness; include friends/partners where feasible without treating six pairs as representative.
Observe rather than enact the shared activity; separately record A and B contributions and any one-person carrying of the task.
Do not prompt saving or replay; distinguish choosing the interface’s replay button from a later voluntary return.
Report assistance, exits, missing data and contrary cases. If fewer than six pairs attend, state the actual denominator and leave six-pair thresholds unevaluated.
Keep participant statements separate from observer interpretation and agent-generated examples.

tasks.title: Choose one response to the baseline, including no change or stop
tasks.deliverable: A brief observation → problem → hypothesis → falsifier decision, with explicit disposition of SH-07/08/09.
acceptance_criteria: Apply all three baseline gates and examine qualitative exceptions before selecting a change.
Select at most one bounded experiment: prediction/handoff friction, complementary activity prompts, or the earned keepsake ending; document why the others are not selected.
If both people do not want the activity, consider revising the proposition or stopping before polishing export.
Identify the expected changed behavior, a result that would reject the hypothesis, and remaining rival explanations.
Keep six-competitor validation open even if the internal pilot is encouraging; an internal result does not replace required competitor journeys.

tasks.title: If selected, address observed prediction or handoff friction
tasks.deliverable: One bounded future interaction variant and a transition/copy specification tied to the baseline issue.
acceptance_criteria: Activate only if SH-06 selects this hypothesis; otherwise record a not-selected disposition.
If prediction becomes optional, a skipped prediction is represented explicitly and the reveal never invents a guess or matching outcome.
If handoff is the issue, identify the exact confusing step before reducing or rewriting controls; the twelve-activation count alone is not evidence of human friction.
Preserve informed pair participation, solo-rehearsal labels, private versus joint curtains, keyboard/touch equivalence and End & forget.
Deliver only this selected flow change on the game’s own future implementation workstream after the decision; no change is made by this planning task.

tasks.title: If selected, make each person’s contribution to the activity clearer
tasks.deliverable: One revised scene-prompt set with a before/after role map and a falsifiable contribution hypothesis.
acceptance_criteria: Activate only if SH-06 identifies weak or one-sided participation; otherwise record a not-selected disposition.
Show the fixed scene activity, A’s selected role prompt and B’s selected role prompt separately so the causal change is inspectable.
Preserve stable scene/choice IDs, three choices per current scene, imaginary/seated alternatives and permission to alter or leave the activity.
Do not demand personal disclosure, add a relationship score or use claims of togetherness as instructions to participants.
Test the proposed wording against the observed confusion; no extra scene is part of this experiment.

tasks.title: If selected, make the ending recognizably belong to both people
tasks.deliverable: A compact ending storyboard and, only when chosen, one bounded keepsake variant aligned with the joint-authorship hypothesis.
acceptance_criteria: Activate only when the activity works but the baseline ending does not; otherwise record a not-selected disposition.
Trace the signature action → contribution → artifact; current SVG content is two optional written lines plus scene title/stamp, not a direct visualization of earlier choices.
Keep each person’s contribution legible in the card and export, including one or two blank contributions; any edit-before-save step preserves mutual agreement.
Use the existing table/window/paper visual language and legible text; do not add unrelated decoration, captured photos or asset pipelines.
Compare recognition of this particular moment, not a generic preference for prettier art; altered exports retain escaping and readable long text.

tasks.title: Check comfortable participation on real devices
tasks.deliverable: A dated device/accessibility matrix with actual observations and unresolved gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Use a physical iPhone/Safari and Android/Chrome where available; record models, OS/browser, virtual keyboard, background/resume, reload, SVG saving and browser history.
Inspect keyboard focus and order, visible labels, zoom/reflow, contrast and reduced motion; record assistive-technology checks actually performed.
Verify a seated/imaginary route and comfortable stop/change-scene/blank-writing route with willing people; do not claim universal accessibility from technical checks.
Exercise the actual hosted embed only when that distribution path is available; the previous synthetic iframe check is not an itch.io device test.
Log severity and reproduction for any barrier; a serious participation or privacy-confusion issue takes priority over expanding scenes.

tasks.title: Integrate only the selected experiment with explicit state ownership
tasks.deliverable: A narrow future implementation branch/patch, transition contract and source manifest for the selected change.
acceptance_criteria: Begin only after SH-06 and the selected SH-07/08/09 specification; document the other cards’ not-selected disposition.
Keep content in content.js, rules/export in state.js, event transitions in game.js and rendering in views.js/CSS; one owner resolves shared transitions.
Preserve ephemeral session behavior, hidden-stage DOM filtering, escaped user strings, optional timer behavior, restart and reset contracts.
Record the exact baseline and variant commits and the smallest changed file set; no storage, backend, accounts or remote-play architecture is introduced.
If SH-06 selects no change or stop, deliver a no-build disposition instead of creating a patch.

tasks.title: Verify the selected variant and preserve evidence boundaries
tasks.deliverable: A verification report linked to the exact reviewed source, or a documented reuse of the unchanged baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Run the existing 33 behavioral assertions only against a changed build or another justified verification target; explain changed expectations rather than preserving a stale assertion count.
Cover affected keyboard/touch controls, private/joint DOM content, all impacted scenes, blank/long/markup text, SVG parsing, timer, replay, cancel/end and reload paths.
Label synthetic Chromium, emulated phone, real-device and human observations separately; passing automation is not evidence of fun or pair authorship.
For unchanged/no-build outcomes, cite the October 20 verification at 822366ad and the no-game-file delta; do not fabricate a new run timestamp.
Resolve any blocker before the follow-up study, and record exact evidence paths and remaining limitations.
tasks.completion_note: The unchanged baseline retains the separately dated October 20 result of 33 synthetic assertions. On October 27, two targeted launch groups passed (root desktop and nested 390px), checking keyboard entry, private-choice controls, reload reset, no horizontal overflow, no JavaScript errors and no HTTP errors. These are two launch groups, not a rerun of the 33-assertion behavioral suite; variant verification and human/device checks remain pending.

tasks.title: Prepare a truthful browser invitation and hosting checklist
tasks.deliverable: A reviewable invitation, short platform-fit brief and package checklist for a direct link/itch.io browser context.
acceptance_criteria: Explain the actual occasion: two willing people, one screen, private choices, a shared activity and an optional keepsake; describe five minutes as a design target until observed timings support it.
Keep a portal such as CrazyGames as a separate acquisition hypothesis with requirements still to verify; do not claim acceptance or audience demand.

Specify the pinned eight-file static export, relative assets, embed sizing, input and download behavior. Link actual local root/nested launch checks with their scope; keep public-host and physical-device behavior unverified until observed.
State that the active session clears on reload/leave and a downloaded file remains with the player; curtains are visual courtesy rather than device security.
Do not claim market uniqueness, memory improvement, relationship benefit, human-tested accessibility or retention; no upload, publication or campaign is part of this card.
tasks.completion_note: Truthful invitation and pinned export/hosting checklist prepared. Two local launch groups are separately evidenced; no public-host deployment, participant study or campaign is claimed.

tasks.title: If a variant exists, compare its targeted behavior with the baseline
tasks.deliverable: A predeclared comparison protocol, actual session observations and a narrow advance/revise/stop recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: Begin only after a selected variant passes SH-12; if there is no variant, record that disposition and use SH-05/06 rather than manufacturing a comparison.
Use fresh pairs or a declared counterbalanced order; state the actual sample, prior exposure, learning effects and missing data.
Choose the target metric/observation before sessions: prediction friction, balanced contribution, or recognizable ending; avoid changing multiple levers.
Record contrary evidence, comfort leaving and voluntary keep/replay; do not interpret a small formative comparison as a causal population estimate.
If later recall/return is studied, obtain an agreed follow-up and report actual attendance; agent replay never fills that gap.

tasks.owner_role: Game designer + research lead + art reviewer
tasks.title: Write the three-question decision brief with unresolved evidence visible
tasks.deliverable: A separate Small Hours brief comparing complete player stories and deciding advance, revise, further study or stop.
acceptance_criteria: Answer why someone might choose this break, how it differs in the chosen browser context, and which signature action → consequence → payoff is worth testing.
Use observed M1/M2 contrasts plus M3–M6 only to their recorded scope; six titles/four families remain an unmet gate until actual qualifying studies exist.
Offer two or three concise alternative stories with a strongest precedent, production cost, likely failure and rejecting observation, rather than a list of desired features.
Include baseline and any follow-up human results, contrary evidence, access/device limits and exact source links; separate human statements from design hypotheses.
A no-change/stop outcome may close the experiment without building a variant; a further-study outcome leaves research tasks visibly open.
tasks.completion_note: Interim three-question hypotheses and bounded alternative responses documented; final decision waits for human and qualifying competitor evidence.

tasks.title: Assign accountable owners and protect the pilot-first sequence
tasks.deliverable: A role-to-person ownership map, dependency review and acceptance/evidence handoff convention.
acceptance_criteria: Name one accountable research owner, human facilitator, designer, content/visual owners, transition integrator, QA reviewer and distribution owner; roles may be combined without inflating sample size.
Distinguish completed preparation from open human and conditional gameplay work; no future feature has implementation evidence before selection and verification.
Do not assign parallel edits to shared transition files; preserve the game branch/worktree ownership contract and source/evidence pinning.
For each conditional card, record selection or not-selected/no-build disposition after the decision; a disposition is not an implemented feature.
Track participant/device/access needs separately from person-hours; share only de-identified observations and agreed artifacts with the integration reviewer.
tasks.completion_note: Agent responsibilities recorded; real facilitator, physical-device reviewer and independent human reviewer unassigned. Assign explicitly before sessions.

tasks.title: Stage one immutable candidate on master
tasks.deliverable: A versioned release-candidates/small-hours/<version>/ package on master, built from the owning game branch.
acceptance_criteria: Record the exact source SHA, version, player-facing notes, build inventory and hash; include a portable build/index.html and only intended files.
Use the release-candidate template and staging validator. Preserve the predeclared human-session protocol before recruiting; staging may contain pending evidence and is not an official release.
Keep the previous candidate and source branch recoverable, push master without force, and verify its remote SHA. Do not merge the whole game branch into master or main.

tasks.title: Review the exact candidate against the human release gate
tasks.deliverable: A complete human-playtest.json and linked anonymized records for the exact packaged build, with a recorded approve/revise/stop decision.
acceptance_criteria: Six predeclared pairs (12 distinct people): at least 5/6 reach the reveal unaided, 4/6 pairs both contribute, and 3/6 voluntarily save or replay. Record the actual choice and both contributions, including failures and assistance.

Include every one of the six predeclared sessions, distinct pseudonymous participant IDs, raw observations and assistance. An incomplete, abandoned or assisted attempt cannot be silently replaced or counted as unaided success.

Zero unresolved critical bugs; manually check actual browser entry, core journey, failure/retry, keyboard, and one physical mobile/touch device. Record measured duration and issues rather than inferring results from automated checks.

An independent human reviewer inspects the evidence and signs the build-specific approval. Existing pilot sessions may be reused only if the protocol was predeclared, participants and required outcomes are recorded, and the artifact hash matches exactly; changed builds need revalidation.
Run full candidate validation. A failed gate stays on master; agent sessions and synthetic test fixtures cannot satisfy human evidence.

tasks.title: Promote only the approved game version to main
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed official release package, registry entry, GitHub version and release-note links, plus a verified playable Pages URL.
acceptance_criteria: Copy only the approved candidate package into releases/<game>/<version>/ on main. Pin its immutable ancestor commit on master; preserve all previous official versions and registry entries.
Open a main promotion PR with human approval and gate results. Required owner review and release-gate must pass; do not auto-merge or include unrelated candidates.

After the human-approved merge, verify automated GitHub release publication, tag target, notes, registry links and the deployed Pages build. A push or draft link alone is not a verified official delivery.
If publication fails, preserve the approved artifact, report the actual failure and rerun only the failed publication step. Never rewrite a released version; publish corrections under a new version.

tasks.title: Verify Small Hours through supported HTTP and hand off pair testing
tasks.deliverable: Dated supported-HTTP evidence and an exact-artifact human-study handoff for issue #5.
acceptance_criteria: Document a co-located HTTP browser route, exact frozen baseline identity, browser/version and root/project-style nested mounts; preserve the original managed-browser/LNA limitation from issue #5.

Complete pair-flow and solo rehearsal with visible controls, both privacy handoffs, both choice/guess stages and both detail rounds; record mode-specific labels rather than treating them as equivalent driver selectors.
Verify the actual downloaded SVG and its two details, Make another moment, End & forget, reload behavior and browser/network errors; compare frozen inventory before and after.

Preserve the unchanged baseline and six-pair protocol. Publish blank human handoff and assistance fields; one operator filling both roles cannot establish voluntary replay, mutual contribution or pair comfort.
tasks.completion_note: 4 November: 8 supported-HTTP lifecycle cases passed across root/nested mounts, 1280/390px and pair/rehearsal modes; actual SVG contents and replay/reset/reload checked, zero reported errors, frozen baseline unchanged. Keyboard/focus, blank/maximum-length details, timer expiry, physical devices and real pair experience were not tested in this pass. This closes technical handoff only; required human studies, devices and release approval remain pending.

tasks.title: Close targeted input/timer gaps and prepare facilitator machines
tasks.deliverable: Dated targeted technical evidence and a practical exact-artifact facilitator-machine handoff; human results remain separate.
acceptance_criteria: Check keyboard/focus through the full baseline path, blank and maximum/long detail inputs, and timer expiry against actual implemented semantics; retain failures and separate driver mistakes from product defects.
Record the exact unchanged eight-file baseline inventory before/after and a local HTTP facilitator setup; verify downloads/privacy reset where needed rather than rerunning every historical case.

Link the canonical blank six-pair protocol and practical physical-phone setup boundary. Human recruitment, sessions, device observations and approval remain unbooked/pending; baseline pilot and decision still precede staging.
tasks.completion_note: 5 November: four targeted groups and 64 assertions passed, including full keyboard/focus, blank/maximum-length details, actual SVG contents, real 45,060 ms timer expiry and a separate clock-assisted interruption. Zero observed browser/network errors; eight-file baseline unchanged. Physical devices and real pair experience remain untested.

tasks.title: Isolate countdown lifecycle and preserve test evidence
tasks.deliverable: A behavior-preserving countdown module, safe browser-run output and verified development source distinct from the frozen study baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Move countdown timing/lifecycle ownership out of the DOM adapter without changing the optional 45-second behavior, cancellation or repeated-start semantics.
Run the existing behavioral suite and focused timer lifecycle checks; verify relevant visible-control behavior and retain actual failures/limitations.

Make new browser runs use fresh external evidence directories and guaranteed teardown. Preserve historical reports and the frozen eight-file human-study baseline; no candidate staging or human result is implied.
tasks.completion_note: 6 November: development cleanup passed 5 countdown unit tests, 33 browser checks, 3 focused timer groups/9 assertions and 2 runner-failure cases. Real expiry measured 45,045 ms; simulated lifecycle checks are separate. Development has nine playable files; the frozen eight-file study baseline remains unchanged and unstaged.

tasks.title: Make development-export verification repeatable
tasks.deliverable: A documented command verifies the nine-file development artifact independently from the frozen eight-file human-study baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Generate two isolated development exports from a pinned source, compare complete file inventories and hashes, and fail clearly on missing or extra playable files.
Exercise the exported artifact over supported HTTP with the existing behavior and timer checks; keep raw attempts in fresh external evidence directories.
Record source SHA, commands, inventory and actual results. Preserve the frozen study baseline and leave staging dependent on its existing pilot/design/manual prerequisites.
tasks.completion_note: 6 November exact-export verification: 13 unit tests, two matching nine-file/60,443-byte exports, 18 HTTP file comparisons, 66 browser checks and three timer groups/nine assertions passed on committed source. Real expiry took 45,051 ms. Four real favicon 404 responses and four matching console events remain a known limitation; other observed errors were zero. The earlier five-favicon attempt is retained. Frozen study bytes are unchanged; no candidate, human or physical-device result is added.

tasks.title: Record the approved two-story direction and product hypotheses
tasks.deliverable: An accepted, evidence-bounded decision for the Vivid anthology and Iona remembered/neutral comparison.
acceptance_criteria: State why someone might play, why choose this browser experience, and which action/consequence may distinguish it; record falsifiers rather than market-uniqueness claims.
Implement the approved multi-day scope: tactile 3D frame plus painted portrait, a full Iona story and a short object-led Mara story.
Keep the six-competitor research ledger and all human outcomes open; approval to implement is not proof of audience preference.
Keep the technical game ID keepers-frame and one Vivid branch; use explicit story packs rather than creating extra game lanes.
tasks.completion_note: User-approved direction recorded and implemented; research hypotheses remain unvalidated.

tasks.title: Finish missing competitor endpoints after six-title reconciliation
tasks.deliverable: Preserve the six-title journey ledger and qualified synthesis, then add the missing Six Cats ending, WBWWB full cycle and ADOFAI tutorial completion as new dated sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Use Sort the Court! Poki edition, Six Cats Under HTML5, Adventures With Anxiety, We Become What We Behold, Townscaper browser demo and A Dance of Fire and Ice browser demo.
Record entry, goals, inputs, feedback, mistakes, recovery, observed stopping point and re-entry where actually reached; partial or blocked access is not completion.
Keep Event[0], TOEM, full native Townscaper and Rhythm Doctor as unplayed native gaps. Do not pool older editions, screenshots, criticism or agent interpretation into fresh play results.
Retain at least four broad families and two titles outside narrative/deduction. Reconcile the complete records before updating comparative counts or conclusions.

Complete Six Cats rescue/post-ending restart, WBWWB cycle/post-completion re-entry and ADOFAI tutorial with heard audio and reliable calibration. Preserve partials and disclose assistance; do not pool separate runs as completion.
tasks.completion_note: October 22 uploads reconciled on October 27 with the distinct October 21 six-title/five-family roster. Galatea supplies one authored conversation ending; photography and rhythm substitutes retain partial/tooling limits. Six Cats, WBWWB and audible/calibrated ADOFAI endpoints remain open; no new competitor sessions or human results were added.

tasks.title: Implement the rescue, recollection and remembered return contract
tasks.deliverable: Pure story transitions for first rescue, The Worn Notch, both Iona return placements and the neutral routine.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve evidence-gated ferry signalling, visible clues, safe wrong-answer retries and no countdown.
After rescue, brace the shade and fit a wedge in an explicitly earlier watch; each accepted action changes the scene before returning to the present.
Private history offers a folded letter in the recess; public history offers an approved dedication on the harbour-facing edge. Completed saves open the return without restarting rescue.
Neutral profile uses the same rescue/recollection and a comparable cloth placement without prior-choice reference; invalid or repeated placement cannot complete a wrong state.
tasks.completion_note: Rules and state scenarios implemented; human understanding is not yet measured.

tasks.title: Author the two histories, consent and action-led recollection
tasks.deliverable: Structured fiction for Iona, truthful legacy continuity, balanced private/public routes and a nonjudgmental Mara ending.
acceptance_criteria: Tie narration to accepted actions and concrete objects, with a readable transcript and no mandatory audio or animation.
Give privacy and public recognition equal warmth. New public sharing approves a dedication, not silent disclosure of the private letter.
Acknowledge an earlier peek on both routes. Preserve the fact that a legacy v1 archive choice published the letter.
Let writers replace cast names, pronouns, descriptions and portraits through pack content; keep those choices out of the shared engine.
tasks.completion_note: Authoring and continuity checks are present; emotional effect remains a human question.

tasks.title: Build original frame, lightbox and persistent object art
tasks.deliverable: Reproducible Blender props and painted SVG layers for both stories, with state-driven Three.js and flat presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Show the notch, wedge, sheltered letter, dedication at the frame edge and neutral cloth on its peg as distinct physical states.
Give Mara a separate workbench/lightbox composition whose drawing layers visibly align; no central talking portrait is required.
Keep editable originals, exported assets and generation instructions separate. Use local assets and no paid-generation dependency.
Cap DPR at 1.5 and remain below 100,000 active triangles; keep human appeal and physical-phone performance explicitly unverified.
tasks.completion_note: Nine automated renderer/art checks passed. This does not establish art appeal or physical-device FPS.

tasks.title: Provide equivalent pointer, keyboard and static interactions
tasks.deliverable: Shared inspect, choose, place and adjust controls with accessible text, focus behavior and optional 3D motion.
acceptance_criteria: Every drag has select-then-tap and keyboard equivalents; sketch adjustment supports a slider and step controls.
Treat camera movement as preview only, clamp tilt to ±12 degrees, and let explicit view controls select discoverable evidence.

tasks.deliverable: A state ownership/reset table and a small implementation patch with one engine integrator.
acceptance_criteria: Define which event, clue and outcome fields persist across midnight, reset on a new run, and remain isolated between Original and Contrast.
Prevent double resolution from repeated Continue input or revisits; preserve pending-action guards, new-scene retention, cancel semantics and once-only forecast reward.
Retain the existing no-save-on-reload behavior unless separately chosen later; label this limitation in the pilot and distribution notes.
One systems owner integrates engine.js; narrative and art contributors work through agreed data/asset seams, not simultaneous changes to the compressed engine.
Record base/new commit, build output hash, rollback reference and touched paths. Do not change unrelated districts or repair Original within this experiment.
tasks.completion_note: 27 October: midnight knowledge, daily/reset/mode boundaries, repeated-input guards, catastrophe and restart were exercised on the pinned candidate; reload still resets the session. Runtime/build identity and preserved reference are recorded.

tasks.title: Verify the cause-and-effect slice and the complete existing path
tasks.deliverable: A scenario matrix, exact build identifiers and visible-control traces/screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Run the existing build, three echo-time tests, 17 static checks and applicable smoke/journey suites against the new isolated build; historical passing results alone are insufficient.
Cover witnessed/unwitnessed clue, correct/wrong/blank forecast, ordinary/borrowed intervention, no Momentum, cancellation, revisit, late/missed opportunity and both Mina outcomes.
Cover second-borrow rejection, atomic spend, locked phase/forecast, reward exactly once, Fracture reaching 4, restart, mode switching and retention of unseen new scenes.
Re-run the existing full ending and restart through visible controls. Publish exact counts and failures, console errors and artifact links rather than a bare “works”.
Block the human pilot on repeatable wrong-state, duplicate-reward or inaccessible-action failures; repair and rerun only the affected checks plus justified regression coverage.
tasks.completion_note: Independent visible-control regression checks are being prepared and run against the selected slice. Final results pending.

tasks.owner_role: Human playtest owner + Bell design lead
tasks.title: Prepare a six-person formative comparison without teaching the solution
tasks.deliverable: A consent/observation template, counterbalanced build order and predeclared decision sheet.
acceptance_criteria: Plan six new participants, three per first-build order: current Contrast then candidate, or candidate then current Contrast. Record genre familiarity, device, prior exposure and any help.
Capture the player’s causal explanation and prediction before the result; prompt neutrally. Treat second-build responses as affected by learning and emphasize first-exposure evidence.

Record help requests, wrong forecasts, rereading, missed-opportunity reaction, Fracture explanation and optional retry/leave choice. Elicit outcome recall after a two-minute neutral break following each run, before the next build or final debrief; this is short-delay recall, not next-day retention.

Predeclare the thresholds below and record the exact denominator. Report candidate-build results separately for the two first-build orders (three each), alongside the six-person total; keep current-Contrast results separate. Do not turn six sessions into a statistical superiority, retention or market-demand claim.
Recruitment and consent belong to the human owner when separately arranged. No invitations or external messages are sent by preparing this plan.
tasks.completion_note: 27 October: the six-person, counterbalanced comparison protocol and blank observation form are prepared, with three participants per first-build order, neutral prompts and at least 120 seconds of neutral activity before recall. Registration, recruitment, sessions, facilitator and independent reviewer remain pending.

tasks.owner_role: Human playtest owner + Bell design lead
tasks.title: Observe six real players and decide keep, revise or defer
tasks.deliverable: Consented raw observations, build-order log and an evidence-linked design decision.
acceptance_criteria: Require six actual new participants and TB-11’s passing pilot gate; an agent run or roleplay supplies zero participant rows.
At least four of six explain the witnessed cause and predict the intervention consequence before receiving it.

At least four of six use the earned action without coaching and explain that Fracture can still end the day; at least three name Mina’s specific changed outcome after the predeclared two-minute break, rather than only extra Momentum.
Record zero repeatable wrong-state, duplicate-reward or inaccessible-action failures. Keep all misses/help requests and build-order effects visible.

If success comes from memorized answers or highlighting without causal explanation, revise the slice; if the outcome is remembered only as a meter, revise the payoff. Incomplete recruitment leaves the decision pending, not passed.
Separate verbatim participant words, observed behavior and interpretation; optional retry is immediate behavior, not delayed return or retention.

tasks.title: Prepare an honest browser pilot package
tasks.deliverable: A local preview manifest, entry copy and itch.io/CrazyGames readiness checklist with dated sources.
acceptance_criteria: State the intended context as an itch.io browser release/pilot; treat CrazyGames as a separate acquisition context whose current technical requirements still need authorized verification.
Package the tested portable build with commit/hash, direct launch instructions, viewport/input limitations, no-save-on-reload disclosure and one clear route into the selected comparison build.
Measure actual loading/entry behavior when implementation exists; do not reuse the 4–8 minute UI promise as a measured human duration.
Use copy about the concrete learned-action payoff; make no uniqueness, preference, retention or market-conversion claim from competitor notes or six formative sessions.
Preparing the package does not publish, upload to a portal, add accounts, purchase services or install analytics. Release is a later scoped decision.

tasks.title: Keep the plan, dependencies and evidence reviewable
tasks.deliverable: A dashboard-ready task export and phase decision log with artifact links.
acceptance_criteria: Keep all cards proposed/conditional/blocked_human until their stated prerequisites are met and work is actually assigned; owner roles are not accepted assignments.
Record TB-03’s settled design before implementation begins. Separate design readiness, QA readiness, human-evidence readiness and final competitive-claim readiness.
For each completed future card, attach the source/build commit, acceptance evidence and open limits; never mark the plan itself as a completed game feature.
Reconcile the new Bell evidence addendum with the older audit without rewriting historical claims as though the recovered records had always been present.
Defer general schedule simulation, new districts/endings, bond/item frameworks, save/accounts, procedural cases, co-op, generalized art overhaul, paid distribution and analytics backend.
tasks.completion_note: 27 October: the settled design, candidate/source identities, implementation limits, verification attempts and human-study handoff are linked in the pinned milestone record. Technical completion is separated from zero human sessions and pending official approval; current progress is reconciled in the dated iteration records.

tasks.title: Stage one immutable candidate on master
tasks.deliverable: A versioned release-candidates/thirteenth-bell/<version>/ package on master, built from the owning game branch.
acceptance_criteria: Record the exact source SHA, version, player-facing notes, build inventory and hash; include a portable build/index.html and only intended files.
Use the release-candidate template and staging validator. Preserve the predeclared human-session protocol before recruiting; staging may contain pending evidence and is not an official release.
Keep the previous candidate and source branch recoverable, push master without force, and verify its remote SHA. Do not merge the whole game branch into master or main.

tasks.title: Review the exact candidate against the human release gate
tasks.deliverable: A complete human-playtest.json and linked anonymized records for the exact packaged build, with a recorded approve/revise/stop decision.
acceptance_criteria: Six predeclared individual players: at least 4/6 each explain cause and predict consequence; at least 4/6 each use the earned action uncoached and explain Fracture; at least 3/6 recall a specific Mina outcome after a neutral break of at least 120 seconds. Keep the counterbalanced first-build groups of three visible in the design analysis.

Include every one of the six predeclared sessions, distinct pseudonymous participant IDs, raw observations and assistance. An incomplete, abandoned or assisted attempt cannot be silently replaced or counted as unaided success.

Zero unresolved critical bugs; manually check actual browser entry, core journey, failure/retry, keyboard, and one physical mobile/touch device. Record measured duration and issues rather than inferring results from automated checks.

An independent human reviewer inspects the evidence and signs the build-specific approval. Existing pilot sessions may be reused only if the protocol was predeclared, participants and required outcomes are recorded, and the artifact hash matches exactly; changed builds need revalidation.
Run full candidate validation. A failed gate stays on master; agent sessions and synthetic test fixtures cannot satisfy human evidence.

tasks.title: Promote only the approved game version to main
tasks.deliverable: A reviewed official release package, registry entry, GitHub version and release-note links, plus a verified playable Pages URL.
acceptance_criteria: Copy only the approved candidate package into releases/<game>/<version>/ on main. Pin its immutable ancestor commit on master; preserve all previous official versions and registry entries.
Open a main promotion PR with human approval and gate results. Required owner review and release-gate must pass; do not auto-merge or include unrelated candidates.

After the human-approved merge, verify automated GitHub release publication, tag target, notes, registry links and the deployed Pages build. A push or draft link alone is not a verified official delivery.
If publication fails, preserve the approved artifact, report the actual failure and rerun only the failed publication step. Never rewrite a released version; publish corrections under a new version.

tasks.title: Verify Bell through supported HTTP and hand off causal testing
tasks.deliverable: Dated supported-HTTP evidence and an exact-artifact human-study handoff for issue #5.
acceptance_criteria: Document a co-located HTTP browser route, exact frozen 0.1.0 identity, browser/version and root/project-style nested mounts; preserve the original managed-browser/LNA limitation from issue #5.

Record visible scene action, resolution and phase progression, including blank forecast, borrowed-time costs, Fracture 4, anchor selection/confirmation and Mina's changed outcome; preserve failure evidence.

Separate scripted known-route checks from exploratory observations. Compare frozen inventory before and after and report browser/network errors; select a copy or rule change only after a reproduced defect and bounded decision.

Publish the unchanged six-person counterbalanced protocol and blank handoff, including at least 120 seconds neutral recall. Repeated agent attempts are not independent first-time players or human gate evidence.
tasks.completion_note: 4 November: 33 scenario executions passed (16 root, 16 nested, one nested desktop ending/restart) on unchanged 0.1.0. Candidate resources had no failures. The frozen historical reference used fallback fonts after its optional Google Fonts certificate failure. Known-route and race-regression checks are not fresh-player comprehension, recall or physical-device evidence. This closes technical handoff only; required human studies, devices and release approval remain pending.

These checks are not a rerun of all historical causal scenarios or human observations.
